name: The Fate of a Loved One
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
narrative.objectives: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.Thank you, champion. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, champion, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.
